purpose: Preserved non-test diagnostics before formal v2 benchmark; no benchmark scores here
source_provenance: Snapshot reconstructed by reversing metadata-only addition and verified against contemporaneously read remote engine SHA. r02-r04 diagnostic script bodies reconstructed from exact recorded stdin invocations; added docstrings describe provenance. r01 was the root-agent engine/mechanical_checks invocation, whose output and original log are retained.

settings.generation: greedy, 16 tokens, stops newline-newline plus EOS248044/248046

r01.interpretation: Batch64 failed calibration, likelihood and EVO generation controls; second synthetic baseline prompt also changed top-choice ranking.

r02.interpretation: Even identical unpadded repeated prompts at batch2 changed calibration. Explicit mask-cumsum position ids did not restore the single-example reference. Padding alone cannot explain the discrepancy.
r02.retained_rows: First two representative repeated rows per diagnostic condition

r03.interpretation: Fixed batch1 calibration did not restore EVO generation equality at batch2/8/64. Disabling BF16 reduced-precision reduction changed the single reference and did not solve equality. These flags were toggled only in a separate completed diagnostic process.
r03.retained_rows: First two representative repeated rows per diagnostic condition

decision: Use actual forward batch size1 for both arms and all tasks; retain exact-context candidate-forward reuse. No thresholds, doses or scoring rules changed.
limit: Only two synthetic short contexts were used here. Long actual non-test prompt throughput and final engine-metadata revision are validated by the root preflight receipts.
